description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarFieldStringmap, which extends SugarFieldText. It provides methods for handling custom string map fields in a CRM system, including preparing data for editing and detail views, saving data, and extracting key-value pairs from request parameters. It is part of the SuiteCRM project, which is a fork of SugarCRM.

classes.name: SugarFieldStringmap
classes.description: A class that manages the string map custom field in the CRM, allowing for key-value pair management within the user interface.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the data for rendering the edit view of the field, calculating whether to show keys and setting labels.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the data for rendering the detail view of the field, similar to the edit view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field data by encoding the key-value map as JSON and storing it in the bean.

methods.name: calculateShowKeys
methods.description: Determines if keys should be shown based on vardef and sets the 'show_keys' attribute.

methods.name: getStringMapFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts key-value pairs from the request parameters and constructs a map.

methods.name: setLabels
methods.description: Sets the labels for key and value fields based on language strings.
